notes.title: Patch Note Ver 1.0.2
notes.content: ・Fixed so that the cursor movement speed does not fluctuate depending on whether vertical synchronization is ON or OFF.

notes.title: Patch note Ver 1.0.1
notes.content:
・Fixed a bug that caused the game to stop when running in the background.
(It is now possible to continue auto-battles in the background)
・Fixed a bug that caused the vertical sync setting to return to its default value when the game was restarted.
・Fixed a bug that caused some jingle sounds not to play.
